exercises.prompt: Tell us about a time you had to wait for someone at work or school.
Some people prefer to work in offices. Others prefer to work outdoors. What kind of work environment do you prefer? Give reasons.
A company is thinking about requiring all employees to return to the office full-time, including employees who have worked from home successfully. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your child's school is considering replacing experienced teachers with cheaper, less experienced teachers to save money. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
